title: CRISPR-HAWK: Haplotype- and Variant-aware guide design toolkit for CRISPR-Cas
authors: Alisa Kumbara, Manuel Tognon, Giulia Carone, Arianna Fontanesi, Nicola Bombieri, Rosalba Giugno, Luca Pinello
relevance_to_cellguide: Adjacent but relevant caveat: shows that individual/population genetic variants (not just chromatin/cell-type) can also alter guide performance (82.5% of guides at 7 therapeutic loci had variants modifying on-target activity), including creating or destroying PAM sites. Worth flagging as a longer-term extension beyond ATAC/chromatin context — relevant to the plan's 'evidence/provenance' framing if the team wants to note donor-genotype as another axis of context-dependence.
